newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shares end slightly higher ahead of CPI.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shares end slightly higher ahead of CPI.

text.p: Israeli shares closed slighty higher on Tuesday ahead of the release of the June consumer price index, traders said.
The benchmark Mishtanim index of the top 100 shares gained 0.03 percent, or 0.09 points, to 299.40 on a moderate all-share turnover of 134 million shekels against 156 million shekels on Monday.
The Maof 25 blue chip index closed 0.24 percent higher at 305.96.
June CPI, released after the end of the trading day, rose 1.1 percent, well above expectations of a rise of 0.5 percent to 0.8 percent.

"The session opened with nice gains following the rise of Israeli shares traded in New York. During the trading day the market lost momentum as investors started realising that the June CPI is going to be higher than expected," said Ilan Doron, head of trading at Solid Financial Markets.
Doron added that share prices are expected to decline in the near term.

"The market made a big move and it's time for a correction. Moreover, a high CPI will stop the recent rise in the bond market. The political situation is also having a negative impact on trading," he said.

Yoram Ben-Yaeir at Ahrayut Investment Mangement said investors were sidelined ahead of the CPI release. "The market was very quiet today and activity was low. Investors are sitting on the fence waiting to see what the figure will be," he said.
Bezeq Israel Telecom, the most active share, surged 3.75 percent to 1,064 agorot on volume of 8.6 million shekels.
On Monday, the government annnounced an agreement to sell 90.6 million shares, or 12.5 percent, of Bezeq to Merrill Lynch for $250 million. Merrill Lynch will sell the shares to clients.

Other active shares included Bank Leumi, which closed unchanged at 574 agorot on turnover of 5.9 million shekels, and Teva Pharmaceutical Industries, which gained 0.5 percent to 22,537 agorot on volume of 4.8 million shekels.
- Dan Gerstenfeld, Tel Aviv newsroom, 972-3-537-2211 x233
